_expect.name: Prow Wall aka River Bend Right

az_prow_wall_aka_river_bend_right.blurb: A compact sport wall in the Prescott area of central Arizona, on the right-hand side of a bend in the canyon floor where the walls form a prominent prow. Seven routes are bolted with no more than seven bolts each, running from 5.9 up into the low 5.12s, so it suits climbers working on harder grades rather than beginners. Most lines open with roughly ten feet of slick, polished stone that makes the first moves feel intimidating. Some routes can also be top-roped. The wall is mostly sunny, with patches of shade that shift through the day.
az_prow_wall_aka_river_bend_right.approach: Walk down the dry riverbed past the neighbouring wall called Valerie's Book until the channel swings sharply right, just beyond a big boulder sitting in the bed. The face on the right-hand side is this wall.

az_godhead_north.blurb: Godhead North is a set of west-facing cliffs in The Refuge, a quiet valley within Lower Devil's Canyon in the Queen Creek area of central Arizona. The cliffs stand opposite The Torch area. Seven routes mix trad and sport, from about 5.8 up to 5.11, with most of them clustered at the harder 5.11 end, so it favours experienced climbers. Some lines give a break from the morning sun, while others catch the afternoon light. Parts of the sun-baked west-facing stone are loose, though the established routes are reported to be sound.

az_sandbox_area.blurb: A small bouldering spot in Redington Pass, outside Tucson in southern Arizona, tucked in a canyon just above a little waterfall. Seven problems run from V0 to V4, centred on a short striped boulder with a sandy landing, with a few more blocks lurking in the gaps nearby. The setting is sunny and beach-like, and the soft landings make it a reasonable choice for bouldering alone. It is a low-key session rather than a big circuit.
az_sandbox_area.approach: Take the main trail into the wash and head up the canyon until a short, blocky waterfall appears. Scramble around it on the right; the boulders sit just above it.
